domain_help_identity.description: I'm Fily, your offline EzFiles companion. I help find and understand files, explain app features, and prepare file actions.

domain_help_offline.description: Yes. Fily's model and file tools run locally once installed. Files must be available on this device and authorized in EzFiles.

domain_help_scope.description: Ask me to find or open a file, explain a supported format, summarize available text, or prepare a PDF, scan, share or tidy workflow.

domain_help_voice.description: Yes, you can use everyday English. Speech input and spoken replies need the app's local speech components; this language model handles the conversation and actions.

domain_help_summaries.description: Yes, when readable text is available. I'll use the supplied document text and explain if the excerpt is incomplete.

domain_help_pdf.description: EzFiles can read PDFs, navigate pages, find supported text, add supported annotations and signatures, and prepare merge, extraction and export workflows. Device and document restrictions apply.

domain_help_word.description: Yes. Modern Word formats such as DOCX are supported. Some complex layout features have limits, and document macros never run.

domain_help_excel.description: Yes. Supported Excel files show sheets, formatting and cached values. XLSX cells can be edited into a new Save As file; formulas are not recalculated.

domain_help_slides.description: Yes, supported PowerPoint formats can be read with approximate layouts. PPTX slide tools can reorder or delete slides into a new Save As file.

domain_help_odf.description: ODT, ODS and ODP are supported with format-specific layout and spreadsheet limitations.

domain_help_books.description: EPUB is supported with book navigation, contents, reading settings and saved positions. DRM-protected books are unsupported.

domain_help_images.description: Yes. Supported images have zoom, pan and rotation. Gallery navigation uses only authorized files, and actual decoding depends on the device.

domain_help_media.description: Android can play supported local audio and video with playback, seek and track controls. Codec support varies, and iOS playback is unimplemented.

domain_help_subtitles.description: Yes, when supported tracks are available. Audio and subtitle selection are separate, and local SRT or VTT captions are supported.

domain_help_zip.description: EzFiles can list ZIP entries. Extracting or opening those entries is not currently supported.

domain_help_text.description: You can read, search and edit supported plain-text and source files within the editor's size and encoding limits.

domain_help_replace.description: Find and Replace supports DOCX, PPTX, ODT and ODP with a new Save As output. The original file is preserved.

domain_help_create.description: You can prepare text files and PDFs from text or images, and scan paper documents. Review the draft and choose the output location.

domain_help_scan.description: It supports camera or gallery input, corner adjustment, perspective correction, filters and optional searchable text. It supports up to 50 pages.

domain_help_ocr.description: The app has local Latin-script OCR. Handwriting and universal language recognition are not guaranteed.

domain_help_tidy.description: Tidy Up finds exact duplicates, similar documents or photos, and category collections. Review results; similarity alone does not mean files are duplicates.

domain_help_permission.description: I search files and folders authorized in EzFiles. Add the folder through the system picker if it is not in the library.

domain_help_share.description: I can prepare sharing for a chosen file. You select the app and recipient and confirm in the system share flow.

domain_help_print.description: I can prepare supported documents for print review. You choose the printer and confirm; opening preview does not confirm printing.

domain_help_latest.description: I'll look for resumes and compare available modification dates. A recently opened file or a filename containing final does not necessarily identify the latest version.

domain_help_off.description: Yes, the optional Fily feature is intended to have an app switch. Turning it off must stop its listening and inference; this model alone cannot change that setting.

domain_help_macros.description: No. EzFiles does not execute document macros.

domain_help_formulas.description: No. EzFiles shows stored spreadsheet values; it does not recalculate formulas.
